← BACK TO HORIZON COUNTY

Made for the open road.

An original browser driving world. The world layout and the Clubsport, Meridian and Summit vehicle models are generated locally in code.

Environment photography

Photographed surfaces and outdoor HDR lighting by Poly Haven, available under CC0.

  • Asphalt 02 — road color, normal and roughness maps.
  • Brown Mud Leaves 01 — terrain color and normal maps.
  • Kloppenheim 06 Pure Sky — environment reflections.

Built with

Three.js 0.180.0 and HDRLoader, MIT license. Barlow typefaces, SIL Open Font License.

All game assets are served with the game. The garage, paint, graphics settings and discoveries are saved only in your browser.
